subject: Improving accuracy of EHR based ML | Working with FlatIron & TargetRWE
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

Saw the growing EHR-based ML work and importance of data quality at Concert AI, thought I'd reach out.

I've recently been working with Flatiron Health and TargetRWE as they looked to improve the quality & performance of their models. We helped them to streamline data curation and annotation workflows to enhance regulatory compliance and efficiency in handling complex unstructured data (EHRs, docs etc). 

Would be keen to trade notes and get your thoughts on what we're building - open to a 30-minute chat this or next week?

subject: ADS perception coffee @CVPR [YEAR]
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on your recent launch in Texas! I saw you're attending CVPR this
year so I wanted to reach out. We've been working on projects w/ Woven by
Toyota, Wayve & Mobileye to develop perception models for autonomous
vehicles - thought it's worth connecting.

A bit of context on Encord.. we help over 200 AI teams improve data quality
for model development by consolidating data curation, annotation and model
evaluation. Typically in AD/ADAS space we serve as a front end to support
their indexing & searching through billions of data items & optimize their
HITL workflows.

Would you be open to a coffee & exchange perspectives? We'll be at the
conference Friday (6/13) to Sunday (6/15). If virtual is easier, happy to
find a time that suits you!

subject: [Invite] Encord's CVPR AI Leaders Fireside Chat & Dinner - 06/14
text:
Hi [NAME], 

If you're around for CVPR, I'd love to personally invite you to a small dinner we're hosting for a group of AI leaders on 06/14.

We'll kick off with a fireside chat featuring Luc Vincent (former VP of AI at Meta, now Chief R&D Officer at Nexar), followed by a relaxed dinner and conversation with guests from Captions, Woven by Toyota, Pickle Robot, and other leading AI/ML teams.

Here are the details:
Date & Time: Saturday, June 14 at 6:30 PM Location: Moto Cucina (a 15-minute walk from the CVPR venue) Guests: A select group of ~20 CTOs, Heads of AI, and Founders from top AI teams. Confirmed attendees include leaders from Captions, Woven by Toyota, and Pickle Robot. This is an invite-only event for Encord partners and selected AI/ML scale-ups - we hope for it to be a relaxed evening for exchanging ideas, not a sales pitch. If you're not familiar with Encord: we're a data development platform helping 200+ AI teams - including Synthesia, Hudl, and Woven by Toyota - bring better models to market, faster.

Would you be interested in joining us?
